prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Follow the visual framing guides so your custom pet generates accurately.", "Select Pet Photos"]
1: ["Your existing pet data and adoption progress will automatically sync upon logging in.", "Data Restoration Active"]
2: ["Discover how your pet interacts with desktop windows while waiting."]
3: ["Confirm Desktop Visibility", "Ensure your companion is visible and positioned comfortably on your desktop screen.", "Finish Onboarding"]
4: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select how you want to create or adopt your desktop pet."]
5: ["Meet Your Perfect Desktop Buddy", "Select a companion with personality traits tailored to your daily desk work rhythm."]
6: ["Start Quick Interaction Setup", "Desktop Controls Quick Launch", "Learn how to move, hide, and converse with your pet using desktop shortcuts.", "Complete Setup"]
7: ["Welcome Back to Your Desktop Pet"]
8: ["Give your pet a unique name and personality trait to officially finalize your adoption certificate."]
9: ["Generation runs seamlessly in the background. Feel free to minimize this window while your pet is prepared."]
